title: Sparsity Saves Compute, Not Samples: Oracle Inequalities for Dense and Sparse Mixture of Experts
abstract: arXiv:2610.15039v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models combine specialized experts through an input-dependent routing mechanism, and their sparse variants underpin many modern large-scale systems. Yet the statistical cost of adaptive routing remains only partially understood. We study the estimation error of least-squares MoE estimators when both the experts and the gating network are Lipschitz in their parameters. We represent each MoE as a gate--expert pair in a Gated Hilbert Space, whose norm $\|\cdot\|_\Delta$ separates the contributions of routing and expert discrepancies. Using its empirical representation, we derive an oracle inequality with a fast rate of order $\tilde{\mathcal O}\big((Kd_{\mathrm{pr},e}+d_{\mathrm{pr},g})/n\big)$ for dense MoEs with $K$ experts. For sparse Top-$k$ and Top-$p$ routing, the selection map is discontinuous in the gating parameters. We handle this by partitioning the gating class according to the selection patterns it in

translated_title: 稀疏性节省的是计算量，而非样本量：稠密与稀疏混合专家模型的Oracle不等式
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型通过依赖输入的路由机制组合多个专门化的专家，其稀疏变体支撑着许多现代大规模系统。然而，自适应路由带来的统计代价目前仍只被部分理解。我们研究了在专家和门控网络对其参数均为Lipschitz连续的条件下，最小二乘MoE估计器的估计误差。我们将每个MoE表示为“门控希尔伯特空间”中的一个门控—专家对，该空间的范数能够分离路由差异与专家差异的贡献。利用其经验表示，我们为具有K个专家的稠密MoE推导出了速率阶为 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}((Kd_{\mathrm{pr},e}+d_{\mathrm{pr},g})/n)$ 的快速oracle不等式。对于稀疏的Top-k和Top-p路由，由于选择映射在门控参数上不连续，我们通过按门控类所触发的选择模式对其进行划分来处理这一难题……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“门控希尔伯特空间”框架，为稠密及稀疏Top-k/Top-p混合专家模型建立了快速速率的oracle不等式，揭示了稀疏路由节省的是计算量而非统计样本量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Gated Hilbert Space framework and establishes fast-rate oracle inequalities for dense and sparse (Top-k/Top-p) Mixture-of-Experts models, demonstrating that sparsity saves compute, not statistical samples.
